The firm adjusted its target to $55.00 from a previous $60.00, reflecting a more cautious outlook on the company's near-term performance. This change indicated potential challenges that Lemonade might face. Despite the lower price target, Piper Sandler maintained its 'Neutral' rating on the shares.
